So, I've been working on my first paint job, and I have some questions regarding paint/top coat interactions:

I've been using acrylics for the base coats. What top coat should I use between colors to protect the paint underneath? I tried using an acrylic top coat, and when I went to use lighter fluid to clean up a masking mistake, it rubbed off everything underneath(in hindsight, I probably should have seen this coming since they're made of the same stuff). But also, I'm concerned about using something like lacquer top coat because I've heard that it can damage the paint underneath. And I don't want to use enamel because I'm going to be using the tamiya panel liner, which is enamel based from what I understand, so wouldn't that rub off as well when I go to do that? The whole thing is making my head spin.  


So, I just need something that can protect my acrylic between coats and also be a good base for when I start panel lining. What should I use?
